OpenPr.prompt:
Push the branch ${vars.branch} to origin and open a Forgejo PR titled "Fix #${vars.issue_number}: ${vars.issue_title}" against base main, body referencing the issue. Use the forgejo CLI (`tea`) if installed, otherwise use:
  git push -u origin ${vars.branch}
  curl -fsS -H "Authorization: token $FORGEJO_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -X POST "$FORGEJO_BASE_URL/api/v1/repos/${vars.owner}/${vars.repo}/pulls" -d '{"title":"Fix #${vars.issue_number}: ${vars.issue_title}","head":"${vars.branch}","base":"main","body":"Closes #${vars.issue_number}"}'

The response is a JSON PR object — return ONLY the integer PR number on the last line, nothing else.

AddressFeedback.prompt:
Reviewer feedback on PR #${vars.pr_number} (iteration ${vars.review_iteration}):

${vars.feedback_text}

Address the feedback in the same worktree (${meta.worktree}). Edit files, run tests, commit, then push to origin/${vars.branch} so Forgejo emits a new pull_request synchronize event.

Return a one-line summary of changes.
